title: Claude Fable 5 & Mythos 5
content:
## Overview

On June 9, 2026, Anthropic released **Claude Fable 5** and **Claude Mythos 5** — the first models from an entirely new capability tier that sits above the Opus class. Fable 5 is available to all users. Mythos 5 is the same underlying model with some safety restrictions lifted, available only to a limited group of vetted cyber defenders and critical infrastructure providers.

---

## The Fable / Mythos Split

Anthropologic introduced a dual-release strategy for its most powerful models:

- **Claude Fable 5** (`claude-fable-5`) — publicly available. A subset of the model's capabilities are gated by an automatic safety fallback: when a query touches certain restricted topics, the request is quietly routed to a weaker model. Anthropic states this fallback triggers in fewer than 5% of sessions.
- **Claude Mythos 5** — available to approved organizations only (no public API as of June 2026). Cybersecurity score of 78.0% on Anthropic's internal eval — nearly double Opus 4.8's 40.0%.

When Fable 5 does not trigger the fallback, it performs identically to Mythos 5.

---

## Key Specifications

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Context window | 1,000,000 tokens |
| Max output tokens | 128,000 |
| Thinking | Always-on adaptive thinking |
| Input pricing | $10 / MTok |
| Output pricing | $50 / MTok |
| API ID | `claude-fable-5` |

Pricing is double that of Claude Opus 4.8 ($5 / $25 per MTok).

---

## Benchmark Performance

Fable 5 / Mythos 5 leads across all major evaluated categories:

| Benchmark | Mythos 5 / Fable 5 | Opus 4.8 | GPT-5.5 | Gemini 3.1 Pro |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| SWE-Bench Pro | **80.3%** | 69.2% | 58.6% | 54.2% |
| Cybersecurity eval | **78.0%** (Mythos) | 40.0% | — | — |

Fable 5 also leads in spatial reasoning, tool use, legal analysis, and health benchmarks over the broader field. The closest prior Anthropic release (Claude Mythos Preview, an earlier preview model) scored 77.8% on SWE-Bench Pro.

---

## Always-On Adaptive Thinking

Previous Anthropic models offered extended thinking as an opt-in mode. Fable 5 runs adaptive thinking always-on: the model automatically allocates reasoning budget based on task complexity. Low-complexity queries use little or no extended thinking; hard problems (multi-step code, research synthesis) receive a larger reasoning budget automatically.

---

## Export Control Suspension (June 12, 2026)

Three days after launch, on June 12, 2026, Anthropic announced it had received a US government export-control directive requiring it to **suspend access to both Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5** globally. The suspension affects API access as well as Claude.ai. Anthropic has stated it is cooperating with the directive and working toward a compliant path to restore access. As of the date of this writing, both models remain suspended.

This has made Opus 4.8 the de facto frontier model currently available through the public API.

---

## Model Naming Convention

Fable 5 represents a new naming tier above the Haiku / Sonnet / Opus family. The current convention as of June 2026:

1. Haiku — fastest, cheapest
2. Sonnet — balanced
3. Opus — complex reasoning
4. **Fable** — frontier general availability (new)
5. **Mythos** — frontier, restricted access (new)

This split reflects Anthropic's recognition that the most capable models require different access policies than the standard commercial tiers.
